description: package.json supply-chain check — Offline npm supply-chain audit of a package.json: install scripts that download or run remote code, known malicious and typosquat package names, versions hit by past npm compromises (event-stream, ua-parser-js, chalk/debug 2025...), unpinned and open-ended ranges, git and URL dependencies, dependency-confusion names, committed tokens, risky publish config. Verdict PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE INSTALL/BLOCK with score and fixes. text= (package.json content) or url= (raw or GitHub blob link). Example: /v1/security/package-json-check?url=https://github.com/expressjs/express/blob/master/package.json Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_package_json_check
